test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'MANNER' is written as 'OETVOD' and 'BEHAVE' is written as 'DINIFQ'. How will 'POLITE' be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'MANNER' is written as 'OETVOD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bab69b69522cd0b82c9a4c6bd67714bee1ecd6d7cb5308f3304725c56395eac.png] 

'BEHAVE' is written as 'DINIFQ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17dac6341096600fe68a4a94dfef5648f5b97ac39a789ca20c3dfc94b503e238.png] 

Similarly, '**POLITE**' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f14cf342845aab2b48eea2aad2b1260de58b2832a657e85407a1e92af1aa1bf6.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**RSRQDQ**".
